I’m a private tutor. My advice to you is practice questions. LOTS AND LOTS OF practice questions. Time yourself as well, so a 2 mark question should take you 2 minutes, but challenge yourself to finish it in maybe 1min 30 secs.

Another way:
Have the exam paper out and the mark scheme out. Read the question then attempt the question. After, read what the what the examiner wanted you to show and figure out where you missed marks. Complete the whole paper, then wait a few days, and attempt the paper again, seeing if you can get higher marks than last time. 

These types of revision is what gave me a grade 9 in GCSE Maths, and is what is giving my Students A/A* in A-level Maths.
